name: nabeeh
description: Nabeeh: daily practice for the Mawhiba Multiple Cognitive Aptitude Test (web + iPhone app)

scripts.ios:prepare: npm run build:www && npx cap add ios && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#0E8A6A' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0E8A6A' --splashBackgroundColor '#EDF2EE' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0E191E' && node scripts/ios-config.mjs && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build:www && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#0E8A6A' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0E8A6A' --splashBackgroundColor '#EDF2EE' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0E191E' && node scripts/android-config.mjs && npx cap sync android
